# Purpose shard: policy 115 116.
# Boundary contract: 1-10 top-level effects; this file has 8.



# 115 匿名内部应聘
zg361_mechanism_115_choice_a_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = zg361_mechanism_115_choice } }
		zg361_init_org_ledger_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = zg361_mechanism_115_choice value = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_org_trust add = 3 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_org_talent add = 2 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_org_admin_load add = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_org_budget_pressure add = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_mechanism_configured_n add = 1 }
		change_variable = { name = zg361_mechanism_checksum add = 115 }
		debug_log = "ZG361M: CASE 115 CHOICE A APPLIED"
	}
}

zg361_mechanism_115_ai_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = just
				has_trait = honest
				has_trait = diligent
				has_trait = compassionate
			}
		}
		zg361_mechanism_115_choice_a_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_trait = arbitrary
				has_trait = callous
				has_trait = deceitful
				has_trait = ambitious
			}
		}
		zg361_mechanism_115_choice_b_effect = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = zg361_org_budget_pressure
			var:zg361_org_budget_pressure >= 25
		}
		zg361_mechanism_115_choice_c_effect = yes
	}
	else = {
		zg361_mechanism_115_choice_a_effect = yes
	}
}
